criteria.description: Build a math formula to calculate the Individual Regular Pay into cell H2 by calculating the product of Regular Pay and Regular Hours for the employee on row 2, Week 1. Demonstrate using the fill handle to bulk copy this math formula down through row 25. Build a similar math formula in column I to calculate Individual OT Pay for all rows 2 through 25. The result should calculate values in the full range H2:I25.

categories.scoring_instructions: If the criteria is met, awarded full points. If the criteria is not met, award 0 points.

criteria.description: Sort the table of data (A1:F25) by Week smallest-to-largest, with a simultaneous secondary sort level on OT Hours largest-to-smallest, without moving the column headers. Do not include columns G:K in this sort.

categories.scoring_instructions: If the criteria is met, awarded full points. If the criteria is not met, award 0 points.

criteria.description: Calculate the Week 1 Regular Payroll for the entire week 1 in cell J2 using the SUMPRODUCT() function using data from the original table (columns A:F, do not use columns H:I for this task). Calculate the Week 1 OT Payroll for the entire week 1 in cell K2 using the SUMPRODUCT() function using data from the original table (columns A:F, do not use columns H:I for this task). Replicate these calculations for other weeks 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 into suitable rows in columns J and K.

categories.scoring_instructions: If the criteria is met, awarded full points. If the criteria is not met, award 0 points.

criteria.description: Add a filter for Column J. Set the column J filter to omit Blanks (if prior steps were done correctly this will reduce the rows to 8, one row for each week). Build a stacked column chart showing the weekly payroll (as calculated in columns J and K) with one stacked column for each week 1-8. The result should have OT pay stacked on top of Regular pay. Name the Chart “Payroll by Week”.

categories.scoring_instructions: If the criteria is met, awarded full points. If the criteria is not met, award 0 points.
